The '''Sharlissia system''' was situated at the endpoint of the [[Sharlissian Trade Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]]. At various points in [[Time/Legends|time]] it was controlled by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The Sharlissia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Sharlissian Trade Corridor]],<ref name="Sharlissian" /> which linked it to the [[Kabal system/Legends|Kabal system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The Sharlissia system was situated in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] at some point between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and by the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]] it fell within the territory controlled by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the system was located in space controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the [[Fifteenth Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with defending the system's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy.<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Sharlissia system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Sharlissia system no longer lay within Separatist-controlled territories,<ref name="TEA" /> and it was situated within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[17 BBY/Legends|two years]] later.<ref name="EGTW" /> The population of the Sharlissia system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 100 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sharlissia system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-18.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
